title: Le Creuset Cocotte Ovale Vintage – Fonte Émaillée – Orange Iconique
description:
Stunning large vintage Le Creuset oval Dutch oven in enameled cast iron, finished in the brand’s iconic orange. A generous, family-size piece—both highly functional and collectible.
✔️ Made in France – stamped Le Creuset – Made in France
✔️ Large capacity – perfect for big meals, roasts, whole chicken, or batch cooking
✔️ Condition: very good – clean interior with light, normal signs of use
✔️ Original lid with black knob
✔️ Classic oval shape for even cooking and versatility
📏 Approximate dimensions:
Length: ~30 cm
Width: ~20 cm
Height: ~10–11 cm
💡 Suitable for all heat sources (including induction and oven)
💡 Excellent heat retention and even distribution
A rare larger-size vintage piece, ideal for family cooking or collectors looking for an authentic Le Creuset classic. Built to last for generations.
